p3_b0.ocr: This report presents a detailed analysis of the comparative effects of various methanolic extracts on different cell lines, specifically focusing on the MCF-7, HeLa, and Chang liver cell lines as outlined in the accompanying data table.

p3_b1.ocr: The findings are contextualized within the framework of the Yuman–Takic, Aztecan–Shoshone, and WMono–Eudeve/Òpata scenarios, which serve to highlight the diverse biological responses elicited by the extracts at concentrations of 27.5 a and 56.4 a.
